Let \(A\) be the origin, with position vectors \(\vec B=\mathbf b\), \(\vec C=\mathbf c\), and \(\vec O=\mathbf o\).  
Since \(O\) is the circumcenter:

\[
|\mathbf o|^2=|\mathbf o-\mathbf b|^2 \implies 2\mathbf o\cdot \mathbf b=|\mathbf b|^2=9 \implies \mathbf o\cdot \mathbf b=\frac92.
\]

Similarly,

\[
\mathbf o\cdot \mathbf c=\frac{|\mathbf c|^2}{2}=\frac{25}{2}.
\]

Then

\[
\overrightarrow{AO}\cdot \overrightarrow{BC}
= \mathbf o\cdot(\mathbf c-\mathbf b)
= \mathbf o\cdot \mathbf c-\mathbf o\cdot \mathbf b
= \frac{25}{2}-\frac92
=8.
\]

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
